plan.text: Win West’s diamond lead with dummy’s ace, then establish clubs while retaining dummy’s heart king as a later entry. After taking the first trick, lead a low club from dummy toward South’s honors; reassess based on the defenders’ plays and the club split. Avoid committing to an overtrick line until the contract position is clearer.
